examined_formations.title: DENTAL_ERA_EOB_CLAIM_POSTING
examined_formations.chinese_title: 牙科 ERA/EOB 理赔入账
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current buyer offers recurring 200–1,000-claim lists and asks for per-claim pricing to download EOBs and post them into Open Dental. But Open Dental natively downloads ERAs, auto-matches claims, auto-populates payments and supports fully automatic processing/finalization; the residual cases are precisely mismatches, CARC exceptions, secondary-claim and write-off judgment that require domain handling.

examined_formations.title: AWS_FUNDING_DOCUMENT_SET_ASSEMBLY
examined_formations.chinese_title: AWS 资金申请文档集组装
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current AWS Partner buyer pays per recurring document set, supplies source material and a benchmark, and expects repeatable template-conforming output. AWS Partner Central now has agents that evaluate opportunities against funding programs and can create fund requests directly, while the remaining document assembly is a generic private-context-plus-template transformation readily handled by general agents.

examined_formations.title: GOOGLE_REVIEW_REMOVAL_SUCCESS_FEE_CASE
examined_formations.chinese_title: Google 差评成功移除按件收费
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current operator pays only when policy-violating Google reviews are actually removed, creating crisp success-based settlement. Google itself owns the report, appeal and final removal decision; the official Reviews Management Tool provides the escalation path. Evidence compilation cannot convert that platform-owned decision into independent operator control.

examined_formations.title: FOIA_BODYCAM_COMPLETED_CASE_PACKAGE
examined_formations.chinese_title: FOIA 警务视频完整案件包
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Multiple current buyers pay per completed bodycam/public-records case and want long-term throughput. MuckRock already productizes filing, agency routing and request tracking at scale. The residual value is finding editorially strong cases, fact-checking completeness, following up with agencies and judging whether a package is compelling—recurring researcher judgment plus external agency response timing rather than a machine-verifiable autonomous loop.

examined_formations.title: PUBLIC_WEB_RARE_COLLECTIBLE_BUYER_INTENT_LIST
examined_formations.chinese_title: 公开网页稀缺收藏品买家意图名单
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current buyer pays for batches of verified public records identifying people actively seeking named high-value collectibles. Clay already combines public-web AI research, bespoke signal extraction, intent monitoring, enrichment and structured outputs at scale. The listed economics are only $0.10 per accepted record, leaving little room for an independent orchestration layer once verification and source rights are included.

examined_formations.title: UK_DOCUMENT_CERTIFICATION_PER_DOCUMENT
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current translation company seeks ongoing per-document UK solicitor certification. GOV.UK requires a suitable professional person to inspect the original/copy and personally sign, date and identify their occupation/contact details. The legally/socially trusted human attestation is the product, so machine execution cannot replace the core value unit.
